### Mid-term review: Scaling Equitable Governance in Area-Based Conservation (SEGA)

[Role: evaluation lead]{.role}

A mid-term review of IIED's programme scaling the Site-level Assessment of Governance and Equity (SAGE) tool across five countries, with fieldwork in Madagascar and remote data collection elsewhere. The review assessed progress against the Theory of Change and verified outcomes against the OECD-DAC criteria, with particular attention to how equitable governance is embedded at site level in line with the 30x30 commitments of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
:::
:::

### Monitoring review: habitat restoration for the Niger Delta red colobus

[Role: review lead]{.role}

A review of a Defra-funded conservation project to appraise progress and refine its strategic direction. It tested the Theory of Change and its underlying assumptions and verified outcomes against the OECD-DAC criteria, drawing on document review alongside key informant interviews and focus group discussions.

### Mid-term review: Global Biodiversity Standard

[Role: co-evaluator]{.role}

A review of Botanic Gardens Conservation International's independent standard for verifying biodiversity outcomes in nature-based restoration, with fieldwork in Kenya and remote data collection in five more countries. It assessed the Theory of Change and verified outcomes, and considered how rigorous and scalable the Standard is across terrestrial, freshwater, and coastal restoration.

### Renewable Energy for Maputo (REFORMA)

[Role: socioeconomic research lead]{.role}

I led the socioeconomic research workstream for an initiative to improve the sustainability of the woodfuel sector in southern Mozambique. I designed the sampling frame and household surveys for a panel dataset and managed the data lifecycle from enumerator training through to analysis, and the resulting policy reporting informed briefings for the Government of Mozambique.

### Urban mapping in response to COVID-19

[Role: research analyst]{.role}

Satellite imagery and geospatial analysis to support municipal pandemic planning. I developed methods to classify urban imagery and produce high-resolution building density maps, which helped officials to identify high-risk areas and target social distancing measures.
:::
:::

### [District poverty in Mozambique](mozambique-poverty.qmd)

Small area poverty estimates for all 157 districts, using the 2022–23 Demographic and Health Survey and open geospatial data in spatial Fay-Herriot models, with calibrated uncertainty and a simulation study.

[Read more](mozambique-poverty.qmd), or see the [code](https://github.com/mirrormerelabs/mozambique_sae) and the [interactive map](https://mirrormerelabs.github.io/mozambique_sae/).
:::
:::

### [Cropland and conflict in Cabo Delgado](cabo-delgado.qmd)

This project asks whether armed conflict caused farming to shrink, relocate, or expand. Land use is mapped for each year from Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat imagery without a fixed cropland mask, and six conflict-core districts are compared with two low-conflict controls. The method is designed to be open and transferable, with applications planned in the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Ethiopia.

[Read more](cabo-delgado.qmd)
